fusions.name: Touch-Hole
fusions.desc: Puts a spark to the charge laid on the target. It deals 16 damage, uses up every affliction you have on the target for 60% more damage each, then sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Tinder Ring
fusions.desc: Lights the tinder laid around you. It deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and sets each [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Buried Firepot
fusions.desc: Buries a firepot at the nearest enemy that arms after 1 second and waits up to 20 seconds. When an enemy comes within 2 tiles, it deals 22 damage to everything within 3 tiles and sets it [Burning] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: One Spark Carries
fusions.desc: When you put a condition on an enemy, a spark jumps to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles and deals 5 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
